mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.name AS category_name FROM ai_assistant a LEFT JOIN ai_assistant_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 0 ORDER BY a.sort, a.id
SELECT a.*, c.name AS category_name FROM ai_assistant a LEFT JOIN ai_assistant_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.status = 0 ORDER BY a.sort, a.id
SELECT a.*, c.name AS category_name FROM ai_assistant a LEFT JOIN ai_assistant_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_assistant(category_id, name, description, icon, prompt, sort, status, create_time) VALUES(#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{icon}, #{prompt}, #{sort}, #{status}, NOW())
